#1. 

- I chose the most popular Ikea designers because I felt that it would be a good type of visualization to show the most abundance invertebrate species at NCOS.
- This visualization makes sense for this the invertebrate visualization because there are 15+ different designers, which is similar to how many different taxa there are.
- All Taxa will be shown in my visualization. There will be a different color for each taxon, and the amount of the color will show how abundant they show up in samples.
